method: Built-in image_gen edits of the existing Matchday Print ticket

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: a reusable blank HOME venue badge skin for the Next Match card in a 1950s football journal game. Use the supplied red ticket only as the Matchday Print material and linework reference. Redesign it as one small horizontal badge, approximately 2:1 aspect ratio, flat front view. Deep vermilion red ink #9a3528 across an opaque, quietly grained centre, fine warm ivory double printed keyline, very small clipped ticket corners and restrained imperfect letterpress edges. This is a quiet informational badge, not an action button or a shield. Keep all border details inside the outer six percent and the entire middle blank for a live Korean label. No text, letters, numbers, icons, logos, mockup, surrounding panel, scene or external drop shadow. One isolated production asset, centered, occupying most of the canvas with a small truly transparent exterior. Fine grain must remain visible when reduced to 40 by 24 CSS pixels; clean silhouette, not heavily distressed.
